claims.claim_text: Gabriel Magalhaes was expected to carry an availability flag into the Gameweek 9 deadline, for the second time in three Gameweeks.
claims.citation_excerpt: For the second time in three Gameweeks, Gabriel Magalhaes is set to be flagged going into a deadline.

proposed_adjustments.rationale: The supplied pre-deadline report establishes renewed availability uncertainty but does not confirm absence or quantify severity; a conservative 0.15 reduction reflects the flag without treating it as a ruled-out status.

notes: This is a proposal-only downward adjustment based solely on the supplied passage.
The evidence was recovered after the historical decision and is exploratory rather than production eligible.
